record.name: Brex
record.one_liner: A fully unified spend platform offering corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.
record.access_note: Sign in to the Brex dashboard as an admin, navigate to Developer settings, and create a user token.
record.api_note: Covers accounting, budgets, expenses, payments, team management, transactions, travel, and webhooks.

evidence.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard
This new open API is available to all Brex customers, free of charge.
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification
Brex MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server that provides AI assistants read-only access
Using the Brex API, you can power your internal tools and create custom workflows.
